Regulator Comment: On September 26, 2014, Senate Bill 445 (SB445) was signed into law. SB445 requires owner or operators to permanently close a underground storage tank (UST) if it was designed/ constructed before 1997 in accordance with paragraph (7) of section 25291 (a) or it was designed/ constructed before 1984 and does not meet the requirements of H&SC 25291(a)(1)-(6). In summary, SB445 requires single walled tank systems (tanks and/or piping) to be permanently closed no later than December 31, 2025. Certain components of your UST meet the permanent closure requirements. There are low interest loans, grants and soil sampling funding available to the facilities that qualify. Contact this department for additional guidance and/or assistance.
